# Sketch Lines reference images

This directory holds the fixed image set used by the Sketch Lines likeness gate
(LUC-47). The images are small, free-licence, and committed so that every run of
`tests/integration/test_sketch_lines_gate.py` measures the same drawing problem.
All files are at most 500 KB.

| File | What it is | Size (px) | Source | Licence | Author |
|------|------------|-----------|--------|---------|--------|
| `circle.png` | Black disc centred on white; checks that a solid shape is covered evenly | 400x400 | Generated by `generate_synthetic.py` | MIT (this repository) | penpath contributors |
| `gradient.png` | Horizontal luminance ramp, black at left and white at right; checks tone | 600x400 | Generated by `generate_synthetic.py` | MIT (this repository) | penpath contributors |
| `sphere.png` | Shaded sphere lit from the upper left; checks smooth tone and shape | 400x400 | Generated by `generate_synthetic.py` | MIT (this repository) | penpath contributors |
| `face.jpg` | Portrait of Neil Armstrong; checks a face at a familiar scale | 800x1000 | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Neil_Armstrong_pose.jpg) | Public domain (NASA) | NASA |
| `photo.jpg` | Lake and mountain landscape; checks a real, detailed photograph | 1280x853 | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lake_Mountain_Landscape.jpg) | CC0 | Bonnie Moreland |

## Rebuild / fetch commands

Run these from the repository root.

### Synthetic images (all three at once, deterministic)

```bash
uv run python tests/fixtures/images/reference/generate_synthetic.py
```

The script uses only NumPy and Pillow, with no random input, so it reproduces
the same pixels every time.

### `face.jpg`

```bash
curl -sSL -A "penpath-dev/0.1" -o /tmp/Neil_Armstrong_pose.jpg "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0d/Neil_Armstrong_pose.jpg/1280px-Neil_Armstrong_pose.jpg"
uv run python -c "from PIL import Image; im = Image.open('/tmp/Neil_Armstrong_pose.jpg'); im.resize((800, round(im.height * 800 / im.width)), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save('tests/fixtures/images/reference/face.jpg', quality=85, optimize=True)"
```

The downloaded 1280x1600 thumbnail is downscaled to 800 px wide and saved as
JPEG at quality 85 (about 144 KB).

### `photo.jpg`

```bash
curl -sSL -A "penpath-dev/0.1" -o tests/fixtures/images/reference/photo.jpg "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/75/Lake_Mountain_Landscape.jpg/1280px-Lake_Mountain_Landscape.jpg"
```

The downloaded thumbnail is 190 KB, below the 300 KB re-encode limit, so it is
committed unchanged.
